# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 22 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Private Home Sales & Supply Pipeline

- **New private home sales jump to 3-month high in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, up 368.6% from June's 156 units and the strongest sales month since April 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

- **Up to 2,550 private homes proposed for Kallang Distripark site** - URA published proposed Master Plan amendments on 14 August 2026 that could convert the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site into a private housing precinct of up to 2,550 homes near Geylang Bahru MRT. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **58-year-old Queenstown HDB terrace transacts at S$1.04M** - A rare HDB terrace house at Stirling Road set a new record as the most expensive 3-room flat by absolute price in Queenstown at S$1.04 million, with around 40 years of lease remaining. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/58-year-old-hdb-terrace-house-in-queenstown-sells-for-record-s1-04m/)

- **Bishan 4-room flat at Natura Loft sells for record $1.3M** - A 14-year-old 4-room flat at Natura Loft, Bishan Street 24, sold for $1.3 million in August 2026, setting a new Bishan record and beating the previous high in the same block by $37,000. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/14-year-old-bishan-4-room-flat-sold-for-record-1-3m/)

- **Clementi Peaks unit sets new 3-room HDB resale record at S$896K** - A unit at Clementi Peaks changed hands for S$896,000 — a new 3-room HDB resale record for Clementi — transacted before the development reached its Minimum Occupation Period (MOP). [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-peaks-first-resale-breaks-3rm-hdb-record-at-s896k/)

## Rental Market

- **Condo rental prices and volumes both hit all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's condo rental market recorded simultaneous record highs in both prices and transaction volumes in July 2026, with the HDB rental market also strengthening in the same period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)
